text:
A painterly, waist-up portrait of a light-skinned adult woman against a muted gray-green background. She faces slightly to the viewer’s left while looking directly outward with hazel-green eyes and a gentle, closed-mouth smile. Her wavy dark-brown hair is loosely gathered at the back, with strands framing her face, and is partly covered by a worn gray-green patterned headscarf.

She wears layered, weathered clothing in earthy brown, gray, and olive tones: a rough hooded cloak over a brown bodice and an off-white gathered blouse. A cord necklace holds a round pendant decorated with a small botanical design. Leather straps and knotted cords cross her chest, and a small bundle of white and purple wildflowers with green leaves is tucked into a pouch or strap near her right shoulder. The soft lighting and textured brushwork give the image the appearance of a traditional realist oil painting.
